headline: More than $2B raised by just three companies building personal AI agents
method: Hark announced over $700M Series A + Instinct $1B Series C + Instinct previously reported $350M cumulative total + Town $55M Series A. Do not add Instinct's $250M Series B separately to the $350M previous total. No AI-lab company-wide funding or valuation is included.

companies.name: Hark
companies.qualification: Over this amount in Series A; personal intelligence platform includes models and hardware. INKS inferred to mean Hark from amount, not confirmed by user.

companies.name: Instinct
companies.round: Previous total reported August 26 2026, including $250M Series B
companies.source_level: Secondary reporting of company disclosure to WSJ; primary total unavailable

excluded.name: Wajo/Bajoy
excluded.reason: Bajoy identity unconfirmed; likely Wajo from project context. No verified funding amount in targeted searches. Wajo official launch page supports product existence, not funding.

platform_context.name: Gemini
platform_context.finding: Already expanding connected apps and booking tasks; not merely an unannounced future arrival.

platform_context.name: Claude
platform_context.finding: Anthropic describes existing multi-application agent tasks in Claude Cowork and Code; does not by itself establish an upcoming general personal-agent launch.

competitive_context.name: Updater
competitive_context.finding: Already markets commerce infrastructure for apps/AI agents, including home improvement and moving. Therefore universal claim that no platform/middleware exists is not supported; actual coverage/completion in GoLocal's intended categories must be checked.

limits: Funding is not adoption, service-request volume, shifted Google local-search share or proven GoLocal demand.
The channel fragmentation and interoperability opportunity are strategic inferences.
Selected-company funding is not a complete industry aggregate.
